(467)༄༅/ /rje btsun ras chung pa'i lugs kyi dpal 'khor lo sdom pa snyan brgyud kyi gzhung chung tilli pas mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (467)༄༅// rje btsun ras chung pa'i lugs kyi dpal 'khor lo sdom pa snyan brgyud kyi gzhung chung tilli pas mdzad pa bzhugs so//

(468)༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra samba ro pa de sha mu kha karṇa pa rampa ra tsintā ma ṇi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsum bdag nyid dgos 'byung bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad ze'u 'bru dri med 'od zer la phyag 'tshal// gsang sngags mthar thug snying po'i bcud phyung yid bzhin nor bu mkha' 'gro'i gsung bzhin rtogs pas 'dir gsal bkod// bde gshegs thugs la snang ba dri med pañtsa pa nas rtogs pas ko ri li ru gsang bdag mnyes// spyod pas zil mnan lus kyi bkod pas rnal 'byor rjes bzung mdzad pa tha mas 'gro rnams stong par byas// bslab pa gsum dang brgyud par ldan pa nyams su myong bas 'jug tshul shes pas bla ma dam par shes// sen dha ba dang rigs cad bran ltar rus sbal spu ste mo gsham bu ltar slob ma skyon lnga bral// mchog gi don 'dod gang gi de bsten thog mar dbang bzhis rgyud smin thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba nyid// 'di don rim par brgyud pa rna bar 'pho byed de tshe sangs rgyas bstan gnas gus pas mnyan par gyis/ (469)sa yi cho ga lhag par gnas pa rig byed slob dpon rig sbyor sogs kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur bya// bslab pas rgyud mdzes thos bsam nor ldan bla mar 'os pa phul ba bla mas gsal stong la sogs bskur/ nyer lnga lhag spangs rigs ldan rgyan spras zag bcas bskul sogs gsum pa byin nas brtul zhugs brtan par bya// dga' ba gsum son lhan cig skyes pa rnyogs pa dang bral yul du bya sogs 'bras bur shes par gyis/ dbang bzhi dang 'brel brda yis mtshon pa shes rab bdag nyid sindhū ra la mnyes sogs ston mos brgyan// slob dpon bzhi la dbang bzhi dus bzhi byed pa bcu gnyis chos nyid dbang la mtshon du med par byos// dbang gis smin nas rim pa gnyis shes rnal 'byor dbang phyug zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i sku sgrub phyir// dbang po'i rim pas dbye dang bsdu ba'i rim pa shes nas 'du 'ji med par rgyun du 'bad pas spyad// tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi gsol dang khams sogs bslab pa 'khor lo tshogs brten rgyu 'bras nyid dang phra mor brjod// go cha ye shes rgyas btab sku gsung mchod dang bzlas pa rdzogs rim phrin las phyogs dang thub pa nyid// bsdus pa'i sbyor ba tshad (470)med bzhi ldan rdzus te skyes pa skad cig rnal 'byor bzlas pa bcas pa nyid// brtan g.yo'i dngos po lhan cig skyes pa snang sems dbyer med rnon po'i spyod yul zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// kun la khyab pa'i ngo bo nyid ston gsal rig mtshan nyid thub pa'i dbang po bde gshegs kun gyi gtso// gsum gsal bdag gis mngon sum nyid du legs par rtogs nas bsgom dang bzlas pa gsal por rab tu phye// chos dbyings skye med rgyal ba'i yum gcig rgyal dang rgyal ba nyid de nam mkha'i ri mo lta// brtan dang g.yo brten dang brten pa lha yi rang bzhin rang la bcug nas sna yi rtse mor rdo rje bzlas// gtor ma sbyin nas dbang po 'bring pos 'od gsal bsgoms te dbang sogs lam dang dam tshig 'bras bur bsre// bdag 'jug dbang dang bla ma mchod byed nyams chags bskang phyir rdo rje sems dpa' brtan pa'i cho ga bzlas// rgyal po blon po dmangs kyi byed pas mtshams kyi kun spyod za nyal 'gro dang khrus sogs rnal 'byor bya// rnam rtog dang bral zla ba drug tu nges par bsams nas grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas rol par gnas// thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad dngos grub mthar phyin zab dang rgya che ba dang gnyis med dam tshig kun gyi gzhi// bag yod bsgom zhing rten dang gsang ba mi bsag mi 'bral bza' bsrung mchog gyur thub pas rab tu gsungs// bslab pa gsum dang rgyu 'bras zhen med dbang sogs 'bras bu rgyud gzhan las gsungs rang sems brtan pas bsrung*// sku gsum la brten ting 'dzin gsum gyis rgya cher rab gsal gzhi lam 'bras bus lta ba mtshon par gyis/

rnal 'byor srog rtsol sangs rgyas mnga' bdag g.yon dang g.yas su rim pa ji bzhin rgyu ba nges pa ste// mnyam par bzhag pas 'jug pa'i rlung nyid bum pa can du byas nas brtan pa'i go 'phang so sor thob/ (471)rlung gi sbyor ba 'di nyid mi shes las dang las min mi 'grub rlung rig pas ni 'bras bu ster/ gdams pas tshe dang bzlas pa'i rim pa goms pas dge dang mi dge 'chi bzlog rlung rig pas ni shes// bya dang byed las chos mtshungs rgyu mtshan gdams pa'i sbyor ba bskyed rim goms pas mthun pa'i rkyen dang ldan// gsang spyod la gnas sdug bsngal bzod pas lus gnad gsum ldan dmigs pa bzhi las sbyor ba'i skyon bsal te// steng 'og bar du 'bugs pa'i sbyor ba li re'i tshul du sgo gsum sbyang bar bya phyir nges par rol// rdo rje bzlas pa yig 'bru gsum la goms shing sangs rgyas lnga la kha dog so sor bslab par bya// 'byung ba lnga yi rlung zin pas ni du ba smig rgyu me khyer mar me sprin med nam mkha' 'byung*// brtan pa'i rtags su zla zer nyi zer glog gi zer dang 'ja' tshon nyi zlar bsres pa dngos su mthong*// spyod lam dang ni sbyor ba mkhas pas dug sogs gzhom dang 'chi ba brtag pa la sogs sna tshogs rgyur/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le 'dres pas bde gsal mi rtog rgyun mi 'chad par rgyal por 'gyur ro kye// rim pa 'di nyid 'phel bar bya phyir snang dmigs dngos po sgyu mar bsams la dben pa'i gnas su ni// rdo rje sems dpa' mtshan dpes spras pa'i gzugs brnyan la ni rab tu dmigs la dngos po chu zla ltar// bcu gnyis sgyu ma'i dpe yis mtshon te mnyam rjes la ni chos brgyad las 'das mkha' bzhin snyoms par 'jug /de ltar shes pas mi bya ba med sngags zlos bsrung sogs mi dgos dge slong sogs la phyag mi bya// nyin dang mtshan dus bsre zhing sbyang dang goms pas gyen du 'bangs te bde gshegs bltas la chos sogs mnyan// rmi lam med dus gnad dang ldan pas 'dod chags la sogs brgyad cu dgag nas snang ba gsum 'das te// rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'od (472)gsal chen pos sa bcur gyur pa lam ma bgrod na rnam shes gang du 'pho// sna tshogs don chen mthong nas shes pa spong ste rim pa gnyis ldan 'jug phyir gzhan gyi mi 'gyur ro// chags dang chags bral 'di ma shes par gzhan ni don med dus gsum sangs rgyas bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// ri bong rgyug dang zla ba chu 'dzin dus dang 'brel pa bslab bcas sangs rgyas dgongs pa mi shes phyir// sgo gsum gnad kyis sbyang bar bya zhing ngal na snad rtser bltas la nges shes skyes nas chen por blta// dang po'i las kyis yid 'ong la brton goms pas sngags las zhing dang lhan cig skyes sogs rtsa bsnyen bya// gcig car mgon po bsgoms nas mthar gnas rdo rje'i bzlas pa rtsal mkhas pa padma'i skyon bzhi bsal// bde ba'i lam drangs ye shes mtshon pa mar la 'du bar rgyu 'bras shes nas zhes bya'i dkyil 'khor blta// thur sel gcud nas glang chen seng ge rma bya'i 'dren dang bya rgod stag mos snang dmigs bde bar 'char// sbyor bar dwangs mas rlung dang mnyam zhing rig ma'i bde ba lus la spros nas rtsa mdud dgrol bar bya// bde ba'i nyams skyes tshogs drug kun la ro mnyam lugs las 'byung dang bzlog pas dga' bzhi mtshon par bya// dga' ba gsum dang dpe don bsres nas rgyu tshogs gzung 'dzin chos nyid goms nas rtsol med 'bras bu 'char// ye shes gsal byed dbang gi 'bras bur rdo rje'i lus la 'khor lor mdud pa spyi bor grol ba'i gnas// sgo dgu bgags nas sgo bzhi thim pa gnyis kyi rnam grol ye shes lus can sgra brnyan lta bur bral// mig sogs stong dang btud bzhi grol ba chos nyid la mkhas gsum po gcig gyur ye shes rgyun chad med// gzhi lam 'bras bu gcig gyur bde chen dngos po ro mnyam yi ge bzhi don 'bras bu (473)mngon du 'gyur// mthar ma skyol na nye bar spyod pa lus lhan bzhi dang ngas shes brtags te ngo sprod shes par bya// skye shi bar do shes pa snga phyir nyid du dran mtshams 'chi ba'i dus su phra rags thim nas ni// 'od gsal chen po de ma rtogs nas bla ma sogs kyi skye la bsu nyid mtshams rlung gsum bcing ba'i phyir// yon tan rdzogs pa bar dor longs sku yon tan bdun ldan de ma brtan na dug gsum las gyur pa'i// rtog par bcas la dbang dus nyams dang lha sogs sgyu ma zung du 'jug pa slob dang mi slob pa// bdun phrag re la brgyal bar gyur ba de ma khegs na skye ba sna tshogs sprul sku nying mtshams sbyor// bar do gsum la 'dod chags la sogs dug gsum shes pa zag med 'od gsal sgyu mar bsres la sgom// 'di don rim pa 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das las rgyal ba gnyis med zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por 'gyur// dbang dang dam tshig 'brel bar shes pa gdod nas dag pa rkyen gyis bskur tshul nyams su blang dang rtogs// bum sogs dam tshig mnyam gzhag rjes spyod mi 'bral bza' bsrung spros bcas spros med yan lag bshags bya nyid// dbang dus lta sogs mtshon par byas la bdud rigs ngos bzung zil gyis mnan nas sgom dang rtags su 'brel// tha ma 'bring dang rab dang mchog gyur 'jug sgo shes pas bsgoms la sbyar te gang dang gang la sogs// mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir 'dod pa dus dang 'brel par spyod pa byas nas gol sa bcad par bya// bya dang spyod sogs tshogs su bsgyur la phrin las byed par rab gnas sbyin sreg rnam bzhis 'dod dgur bsgyur// 'khor lo bzhi la sku bzhir yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje sems dpa' sgo gsum ngo sprod mtshon dpes spras// rgyud rnams snying phyung man ngag bcud bsdus lam gyi rim pa bde (474)gshegs kun thugs yid bzhin nor bu nyid/

mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar bya phyir 'jug pa'i tshul dang zhugs pa'i 'bras bu gsal ba'i thabs nyid do// lus la go gyon ngag gis g.yul sprod sems kyis mtshon bsnun sku gsung khrus bcud rlung dang 'khor lo bskor/ rtsa ba drug la yan lag so dgus nad la sman dpyad bar chad srung 'khor gnad bral gegs bsal te/ sa la sogs pa'i ro bzhi ngos bzung 'khor lo bzhi yis ra bzhi mnyam la zhi gnas phyogs la ni/ thabs dang ldan pa pi wang sgra sogs rtsa rlung la ni shes rab sku gsum mthun sbyor rdzas sogs lnga/ zin dang ma zin legs par shes nas lus kyi gnad la nyi ma zla sogs brdzis nas rdul sprugs byed/ 'byung bzhi rlung la lte ba la sogs stong ra bcas nas na tsha bogs 'don 'gags 'khyil la sogs bsal/ bcu ba'i rlung shes ting 'dzin rang grol sman pa lta bus brgyad po bsal nas dngul chu ltar sprang bya/ dwangs ma bsrubs nas skyon rnams sel phyir bdag tu lta ba'i bud shing bsregs nas 'od gsal chos skur bsgral/ 'di don rim brgyud bla ma la bsten gus pas blang phyir byin rlabs lam khyer snyan nas snyan du brgyud/ mchog gi blo can brtse ba chen pos theg gzhan spangs pa smin dang grol ba rim pa gnyis la 'bad/ snod bcud la sogs gzhal yas khang dang phung po khams sogs lha ru dag pas rgyal ba thams cad bsdu ba'o// rdo rje'i lus la bde chen gnas pas pho nya la sogs spros dang spros med 'khor lo zung du 'jug /rim pa 'di la mos pa brtan pas sprul pa mthong zhing skyon yon dang bcas chung ngu yin phyir tshogs/ skad cig bzhi yis dga' ba gsum son 'bring po'i drod de lhan cig skyes pa dhū tī'i lam zhugs nas/ 'jig rten las 'das brgya phrag bdun (475)po yon tan gyis spras gnas dang nye gnas nyi shu bzhi la sogs// dwangs ma yas byon pūlli sogs khyab rgyu ba mas brtan bde chen brtol nas ma chags padma'i sa// rab bkram chen po phrag bdun yon tan ye shes gsal// byed chos sku bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur// 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rdzogs la sogs gting dpag dka' ba gsal por rab phye snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i gsang*// dri med bsags pa'i dge ba des ni sa gsum gnas pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par shog

/yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang tshig tilli pas bkod pa rdzogs so// gtsigs kyi rgya mdud dang bcas pa nā ro paṇḍi ta'i zhal snga nas dang*// lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis puṣpa ha ri'i gnas su bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i gzhung gi bsdus don rnam par zur mang snyan brgyud las so bshad pa bzhugs so// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba yi// gnas 'gyur bde chen mkha' 'gro ma yi gsung*// snyan brgyud snying po gsal ba'i sgron me 'di// ston pa'i bla ma yi dam lha la 'dud/ yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba'i gzhung chung rdo rje'i tshig le'ur byas pa 'di 'chad pa la/ brjod bya ni gang*/ dgos pa ni ci/ 'brel po ni du zhe na/ dang po ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam phyin ci ma log par ston pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ dbang po rnon po tshe 'di nyid la mchog thob par byed pa'o// gsum pa ni/ don de nyid mtshon pa dbang bzhi dang 'brel pa rgyun chags su ston pa gzhung chung gsal bar byed pa la// dang po sku gsum bdag nyid ces pa/ rkang pa gcig gis bla ma gsum la phyag 'tshal ba bstan// gsang sngags ces pa rkang pa gcig gis gzhung brtsam pa dam bca' bar bstan// bde gshegs zhes pa rkang pa gnyis kyis slob dpon (476)gyi che ba bstan/ bslab pa gsum zhes pa rkang pa gcig gis yon tan drug bstan/ son rda zhes rkang pa gsum gyis slob ma'i mtshan nyid lnga bstan/ sa'i cho ga zhes pas bum dbang bstan/ bslab pa zhes pas gsang dbang bstan// nyer lnga zhes pas shes rab ye shes bstan/ dga' ba zhes pas dbang bzhi pa bstan/ dbang bzhi zhes pas byin rlabs dang tshogs 'khor bstan/ slob dpon bzhi zhes pas dbang mdud grol ba bstan/ dbang gi zhes pa rkang pa bzhis 'khor lo rgyas pa rnal 'byor bcu drug du bsgom pa bstan/ bsdus pa'i zhes pa rkang pa gsum gyis bsdus te bsgom pa lnga po bstan/

gsum gsal zhes pas nges pa rgyu mtshan bstan/ chos dbyings zhes pa rkang pa gsum gyis rgyal po chos nyid bstan/ bdag 'jug gi ces pas blon po rags gsum bstan/ rgyal po zhes pas 'bangs phal pa'i bye ba bstan/ rnam rtog dang zhes pas bsgrub pa'i dus bstan/ thub pa'i zhes pas dam tshig mdor bstan/ bag yod ces pa rkang pa gnyis kyis zab pa'i dam tshig bstan/ sku gsum zhes pas rgya che ba dang gnyis med bstan/ rnal 'byor zhes pa rkang pa bzhis rdo rje bzlas pa'i dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan// bya dang zhes pas rkang pa gsum gyis rlung bsdom pa'i rim pa bya ba dang bcas pa bstan/ rdo rje'i zhes pas rlung 'gogs pa'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa bstan// 'byung ba lnga zhes pa rkang pa gsum gyis nyams kyi 'char tshul bstan pa'i rtags phan yon dang bcas pa bstan/ rtsa dang zhes pas 'bras bu bstan// rim pa zhes pa rkang pa bzhis sgyu ma lta bu'i lam bstan/ nyin dang zhes pas sgyu ma de goms par bstan/ rmi lam zhes pa rkang pa phyed gnyis kyis 'od gsal gyi rim pa bstan/ lam zhes pa rkang pa phyed dang gnyis kyis (477)lam stegs mam cha rkyen bstan// chags dang zhes pas dbang gsum pa'i gang zag bstan// ri bong zhes pas dus dang dgos pa bstan// sgo gsum zhes pas sbyong ba'i thabs bstan// dang po zhes pas las rgya'i rigs bstan// gcig car zhes pas dbang bsgom pa'i tshul dang rtsa'i bye brag bstan// bde ba'i zhes pas dbang dang bzung ba bstan// thur sel ces pas drang zhing dgram pa bstan// sbyor ba zhes pas rjes spyod kyi tshul bstan// bde ba'i zhes pas nyams kyi rtogs pa dga' ba bzhi bstan// dga' ba zhes pas dpe don dang sa lam bstan// ye shes zhes pas dga' bzhi dang phyag rgya chen po'i cha nas bstan/ sgo dgu zhes pas de'i bya ba bstan/ mig sogs zhes pas phyag rgya chen po'i dus sam byed pa bstan// bzhi lam zhes pas de'i ngo bo bstan/

mthar ma zhes pas nye bar spyod pa'i bar do mdor bsdus te bstan/ skye shi zhes pas shes pa snga phyi'i bar do bstan// 'od gsal zhes pas skyel bsu dang mtshams sbyar bstan// yon tan zhes pas bar do dang po la sangs rgyas par bstan/ rtog par zhes pas gnyis pa la sangs rgyas par bstan/ bdun phrag re la zhes pas nyid mtshams sbyor ba bstan// bar do zhes pas dus gsum rig gsum bstan// 'di don zhes pas 'bras bu bstan// da'ang dang zhes pas smin par bya ba'i lam bstan/ bum sogs zhes pas de'i dam tshig bstan/ dbang dus zhes pas bdud ngos bzung ba dang lta ba bstan/ tha ma zhes pas bsgom tshul bstan/ mchog ces pas spyod pa byed thams bstan/ bya dang zhes pas tshogs bsgyur dang phrin las bstan/ 'khor lo zhes pas sku bzhi'i byung tshul bstan/ rgyu rnams zhes pas mtshan (478)pas mtshan bstan// mi mthun zhes pas gegs 'byung ba'i rgyu dang byung ba'i rtags bstan/ lus la zhes pas de bsal thabs bstan/ rtsa ba zhes pas 'khrul 'khor gyi byed pa bstan/ sa la sogs zhes pas ro mnyam pa bstan/ thabs zhes pas thabs shes rab kyi gegs sel bstan/ zin dang zhes pas 'dra gnyis nor la re bstan/ 'byung ba bzhi zhes pas rlung dang phrin las bstan/ bcu pa'i zhes rlung bcu gnas kyi bye brag dang dwangs ma'i skyon sel ba bstan/ dngas ma zhes pas 'od gsal du skye ba bstan/ 'di don zhes pas gus pas mnyan par gdams pa bstan/ mchog ces pas 'di ma yin pas spangs pa la rim pa 'di ldan par bstan/ snod bcud ces pas dkyil 'khor gcig la dkyil 'khor thams cad bsdus par bstan/ rdo rje zhes pas shes rab kyi lam thams cad gcig yin par bstan/ rim pa zhes pas tshogs lam bstan/ 'jig rten zhes pas mthong lam bstan/ dwangs ma zhes sgom lam bstan/ rab bkram zhes pas mthar phyin pa'i lam bstan/ 'khor lo zhes pa rkang pa gnyis kyis gzhung gi dge ba bsngo ba bstan to// yid bzhin nor bu'i gzhung chung gi rnam bshad rdzogs so/// ///
